Add interactive mode for phx.new

Every time I initialize a Phoenix project, I have to triple check the docs to figure out which flags to use. It would be nice if there were an interactive mode.  I made it sort of opinionated and not 1:1 with all the flags. Let me know what you guys think.  https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9eba74b6-1015-47e4-8710-36282ca1163f
